item.title: Local AI in 2026: A 27B Model Beats Sonnet 4.6, and the Hardware Window Is Closing
item.category: "Local AI" , "Self-Hosted AI" , "Open Source Models" , "AI Hardware" , "Machine Learning" , "Quantization" , "Homelab" , "Privacy" , "AI Economics" , "Consumer Hardware"
item.description: Qwen3.8 27B and its ternary repack Bonsai 2 27B now outscore Claude Sonnet 4.6 on the aggregate intelligence index while running on one consumer GPU. What changed, what the benchmarks show, and why memory pricing makes waiting the most expensive option.

item.title: Mining Pearl (PRL) in 2026: Setup, Profitability, and Whether the Chain Is Useful
item.description: How to mine Pearl (PRL) with SRBMiner, what proof-of-useful-work computes, why margins compressed after launch, and an honest assessment of whether the chain produces anything anyone buys.

item.title: Docker in LXC on Proxmox: Reliability, Evidence, and VM Migration
item.description: Evaluate Docker inside Proxmox LXC with a documented AppArmor failure, a careful reading of a host-freeze report, diagnostic commands, and a VM migration plan.

item.title: Field-Deployable Edge Compute: Hardware and Enclosure Selection
item.category: "Edge Computing" , "Field IT" , "Hardware" , "Homelab" , "Rugged Computing" , "Networking" , "Disaster Recovery" , "Small Business IT"
item.description: A practical guide to building rapidly deployable, compact edge-compute mini data centers. Covers chassis and enclosure selection, mini-PC and thin-client compute, rack versus sled layouts, cabling, cooling, storage, out-of-band management, and international power compatibility for boxed-up field IT.

item.title: Proxmox VE 8 to 9 Upgrade Guide
item.description: Complete guide to upgrading Proxmox VE 8 (Debian Bookworm) to Proxmox VE 9 (Debian Trixie). Covers prerequisites, step-by-step manual upgrade, the pve8to9-upgrade.sh automation script, breaking changes, and known issues.
